mutations.because: The plausible simplification: every request already has a ceiling, so composing the run signal looks redundant. It is not - the ceiling bounds ONE request, while the run signal is what stops the calls an abandoned run has not made yet. Dropping it leaves a cancelled run still spending on its remaining cells, and every adapter test that aborts a run and asserts the passed signal follows it goes red.
